newsitem.title: USA: UAL to work with NASA on flying observatory.
newsitem.headline: UAL to work with NASA on flying observatory.

text.p: UAL Corp, the parent of United Airlines, on Tuesday said it would become part of a consortium set up to work with the National Aeronautics and Space Administration on developing a flying observatory.

The company's UAL Services division will sell one of its Boeing 747s to NASA. The plane will be outfitted with a special telescope to study the infrared radiation given off by planets. The flying observatory is expected to be operational by 2001, UAL said.
UAL received a 10-year contract from NASA to manage and maintain the jetliner under the Stratospheric Observatory For Infrared Astronomy program.
UAL stock was up 1/4 at 58-5/8 in early afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
